seo.title: Jamie Seoh (서동완)
seo.description: Software Engineering student at the University of Waterloo; hackathon organizer, composer, clarinetist, and photographer

bio1: I study software engineering at <uw>University of Waterloo</uw>. I'm a native Korean speaker, and I moved to Canada in the fall of 2019. This summer, I am working at <cerebras>Cerebras Systems</cerebras> as an AI Software Engineering Intern, building low-level C++ infrastructure and debugging tools for inference.
bioMusic: I have a great passion for music during my spare time. I am a <roles></roles>
bioCommunity: Additionally, I'm a big community contributor. Currently, I'm a Logistics Organizer at <htn>Hack the North</htn>. Previously, I was the Sponsorship Director at Ignition Hacks, Events at UW Korean Student Association, Hack the Ridge President, and more.

previews.uw: Canadian university known for its world-class co-op program and top-ranked engineering and computer science schools

experiences.blurb: Building low level C++ infrastructure and inference debugging tools for Cerebras' wafer-scale AI systems (the world's largest and fastest chip).
Autonomy software on the Eve team for Waterloo's self-driving vehicle and autonomous racing project.
Built Mission Control interfaces for satellite operations on the Ground Station team — React & TypeScript front of a FastAPI backend.
Engineered full-stack web features that grew the platform to 50+ active users.
Prototyped responsive UI in Figma & React to support front-end development.
